name: Jade
source:
Jade, sister of Emma, is out spoken and blunt but quickly crumbles when faced with someone that she has a crush on. Despite the rough exterior Jade will do anything to protect the ones that she loves, her sister especially. Jade has some sexual experience but also has many fantasies that have been left un-fulfilled.
